notes.title: Catan VR update 1.1.50
notes.content:
Hey all,

We have been working hard to ensure that you have the ability to reconnect to your online game, should you get dropped, and we have reached success! In the rare event that your internet drops out and you are kicked from your game, you can now hop back in seemlessly and keep going!


Reconnect to dropped multiplayer game added!
Fix for player quitting during discard phase.
Lobby timer added to avoid players locking up open games.
Admin functionality added.
Concede message changed for clarity.
Minor art changes.
